name: accept_provider_catalog_suggestions
description: Stores the catalog's facts for the named models as operator facts tagged catalog@<sha256>. It changes the provider configuration, so certified capabilities return to declared and must be certified again.

catalog_sha256.description: Digest of the catalog the suggestions were reviewed against; a different catalog answers 409.

name: apply_configuration
description: Changing project end-user defaults or attribution policies also requires the keys operation; unchanged policies do not. Changes to project route groups also require keys permission. Changing project aggregate budgets additionally requires keys; changing installation_budget requires settings. Unchanged policies do not require these additional scopes. Changing project limit templates also requires keys; unresolved local references prevent application. Workload issuer definitions require installation-wide access in addition to configure; this also applies to unchanged apply and replay. Identity endpoints are fetched only when newly enabled or changed, through identity egress.

expected_digest.description: Digest the destination must still export for the apply to proceed

secret_bindings.description: Write-only map from credential_ref to secret; never echoed, audited, or replayed. A slot a grant backs takes no binding.

external_credential_bindings.description: Destination bindings for logical credential references. Stored without resolved values; new versions must pass validation before activation. A name cannot also appear in secret_bindings.

ConfigurationDocument.description: Secret-free desired-state artifact identified by natural names, never UUIDs

exported_at.description: Informational only; excluded from the artifact digest

templates.description: Route templates; omitted when the installation declares none

installation_budget.description: Installation cap. Omitted or null preserves destination policy; an empty policy clears it. Exports always include the current policy. Changes require settings permission.

budget_time_zone.description: Requested IANA budget time zone. Export includes it. Omission/null preserves the destination. Changes require settings permission and activate independently at the next existing day/week/month boundary; current spend and calendar history remain intact.

organizations.description: Portable organization names and budgets. Memberships remain destination-local. Creation requires access; changing a budget additionally requires manage_organization and authority over that organization.

workload_issuers.description: Upserts workload trust by exact issuer URL and remaps project names. Omitted or empty preserves destination issuers; disable explicitly. Subjects, digests and signing keys are not portable. Export containing issuers, plan with issuers and apply with issuers additionally require installation access, including replay and unchanged definitions.

scim_group_mappings.description: Upsert role and project grants by group display name. Source IDs, external IDs, users and memberships stay local. Missing groups are created empty. Omission preserves destination mappings; an explicit empty grant set clears the named group. Export, plan, apply and replay containing these mappings additionally require installation Access.

require_local_mfa.description: Local sign-in second-factor requirement. Omitted/null preserves destination policy. Changes additionally require installation access authority; factors, recovery codes, challenges and sessions are never portable.

saml.description: Omission/null preserves SAML. Export, plan, apply and replay containing SAML additionally require installation access authority. Set enabled=false explicitly to disable; the usable-owner safeguard still applies.

ConfigurationTemplateEntry.description: A route template keyed by name. Applying stores it; provider activation and the template's apply operation generate its routes.

project.description: Project name, or null for an installation-wide template

RouteFidelity.description: Route fidelity declaration. An omitted or null declaration, and an object without a mode, declare a strict route; nothing is inherited from an earlier draft or revision. Every stored draft, revision and exported route states its mode.

mode.description: Strict preserves execution, observation, permitted continuation and effects relative to the selected target's native invocation. Transformed permits changing an invocation or its observed result, such as translating between dialects or redacting content. Native identity and qualified interaction are per-plan classes.

max_attempts.description: Optional request ceiling; cannot exceed the published route budget.

priority.description: Admission class for this request, up to the key's max_priority. Only the X-OLP-Routing header carries it; routing policies refuse it.

AdmissionPriority.description: Admission class of a request. A saturated gateway dequeues critical, high, normal and low 8:4:2:1, and capacity shares divide provider quotas between them.

provider.description: Provider name, or null for a provider-kind price

end_user_defaults.description: Portable per-end-user defaults. Destination-local digest overrides and blocks are preserved.

attribution_policy.description: Portable project attribution requirements and pinned defaults. Changing this policy additionally requires keys authorization.

route_groups.description: Portable project route groups. Omitted, null or empty removes groups. Changes require keys permission as well as configure.

budget.description: Aggregate project cap. Omitted or null clears caps without resetting spend; changes require keys permission.

limit_templates.description: Omitted/null preserves destination templates; an empty object clears unused templates. Changes require keys as well as configure. Referenced templates cannot be removed.

end_user_limit_template.description: Project limit-template name. Every non-null template dimension is a ceiling; inline limits may only tighten it. Updates propagate at authority refresh. Null detaches the reference.

attribution_budgets.description: Portable project label/value caps. Omitted/null/empty clears caps without resetting accounting. Changes additionally require keys permission.

organization.description: Organization name. Omitted/null preserves destination membership. First assignment requires installation access authority; existing membership cannot change.

public_catalog.description: Owner-enabled anonymous catalog. Changing this value through promotion requires installation access scope.

public_catalog_prices.description: Independent opt-in for published catalog prices.

weekly_cost_limit.description: Optional ISO-Monday weekly cost ceiling. Independent of daily and monthly ceilings; unknown accrued spend fails closed.

RouteGroups.description: Project-local named sets of ordinary or subscription route slugs. Empty groups grant no routes. Unknown slugs may be declared ahead of route creation; project isolation still applies.

weekly_cost_limit.description: Optional ISO-Monday weekly cost ceiling. Independent of daily and monthly ceilings; unknown accrued spend fails closed.

network_credential_ref.description: Portable secret binding name, conventionally provider name followed by /network. Export omits runtime network credential UUIDs; supply this reference through secret_bindings when applying the artifact.

project.description: Project name, or null for an installation-wide provider

bindings.description: Serving bindings keyed by configured upstream model.

credential_headers.description: Header names whose values are supplied in the encrypted credential JSON.

operation_defaults.description: Defaults keyed by operation; each set names its owning profile dialect.

query_settings.description: Profile-allowlisted semantic query settings; cannot replace operation addressing or authentication.

semantic_headers.description: Profile-allowlisted semantic and version headers, separate from encrypted credential headers.

defaults.description: Operation defaults overriding the provider defaults by whole member.

modalities.description: Matches when the input carries any of these modalities.

digest.description: SHA-256 digest of an approved confined plugin exporting route_predicate

RouteAffinity.description: Keeps requests that carry the same session key on the same target and slot while it stays eligible, by hashing the key into the rendezvous seed.

label.description: Attribution label carrying the session key when source is label.

match.description: Exact string matches at JSON pointers. The first matching mapping wins; an empty object matches all verified subjects.

project.description: Project name in the document or destination.

credential_ref.description: Deterministic exported logical signing reference; destination bytes are supplied separately.

name: apply_route_template
description: Applies the template to the certified models of every active connection it selects, catching up models certified before it existed. Provider activation applies every template automatically.

name: cancel_grant_enrollment
description: Cancels a grant enrollment its principal started and has not continued, deleting its session state.

name: continue_grant_enrollment
description: Continues a grant enrollment that has an authorization URL with what the upstream returned: the plugin exchanges the pasted callback URL or code for a grant. OLP creates a credential version recording the plugin, the observed principal and the grant facts, holds the grant beneath it, and stages it on the enrollment's credential slot. A grant enrollment is continued once, by the principal that started it, before it expires.

input.description: What the upstream returned after the operator signed in: the whole loopback callback URL it redirected the browser to, or the code it displayed.

allow_provider_state.description:
Permits stateful provider resources under this key. Provider state
may retain user content; defaults to false.

allowed_attribution_keys.description: Attribution keys this key may report via the X-OLP-Attribution header; at most 8, each a short machine token.

budget_group_id.description: Shared budget group; must belong to the same project as the key (both may be null).

project_id.description: Owning project; omit or null for an installation-wide key. Required for assigned principals.

response_metadata.description: Opts this key into the X-OLP-Attempts, X-OLP-Route-Revision, X-OLP-Provider and X-OLP-Cost response headers on inference responses (X-OLP-Cost on unary responses only). The gateway names the serving provider in a header only with this opt-in; the message of an upstream rejection is relayed after credential redaction whatever the policy. Defaults to false.

priority.description: Admission class of requests that name none; defaults to normal.

max_priority.description: Highest class a request may choose through X-OLP-Routing; defaults to priority.

end_user_source.description: Required end-user identity source: header reads X-OLP-End-User; native reads OpenAI safety_identifier (preferred) or user, or Anthropic metadata.user_id from JSON bodies. Tokens are 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores, colons or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit. Use header for other surfaces. Null disables identification. Only a project-scoped HMAC digest is retained.

required_attribution_keys.description: Required attribution labels, in addition to project requirements. Missing labels return 400 missing_attribution before dispatch.

attribution_defaults.description: Operator-pinned labels added to accounting. Callers may omit them or supply the same value; overriding them is refused. Project pins also apply.

allowed_route_groups.description: Existing group names in this key’s project. Grants the union of explicit allowed_routes and these groups. Both lists empty allow all routes in the project; missing or empty referenced groups grant nothing.

rotation_interval_days.description: Declared rotation reminder interval from creation or the last explicit rotation. Does not expire or automatically rotate the secret. Null disables rotation reminders.

Existing accrued and in-flight costs are unchanged. Authorization is keys plus project-manager access, or installation settings for the installation target.

CreateNotificationRuleRequest.description: A budget.threshold rule requires subject_kind, subject_id, window_kind and threshold_percent, and its subject and destination belong to its project. window_kind.description: For key.expiring, set only subject_kind=api_key and subject_id.

NotificationEvent.description: What a notification rule subscribes its destination to. budget.threshold: an API key's or budget group's spend crossed a threshold in a window. provider.grant.lapsed: a grant can no longer be refreshed, so its credential version's slots are ineligible until a new grant enrollment; a provider event concerns the whole installation. key.expiring: an API key expires or reaches its declared rotation date within 24 hours, or is overdue. One metadata-only delivery per rule, key, reason and date; never creates or transmits a secret.

BudgetSubjectKind.description: Whose spend a budget.threshold rule watches.

tokens at the full input rate.
